title: Bent optical waveguide finite element analysis with a 3D envelope Maxwell model
summary: With the goal of accurately extracting the optical field losses in a three-dimensional (3D), circularly coiled waveguide (e.g., bent optical fiber), this effort presents the numerical methodologies that are implemented for an envelope Maxwell model that propagates electromagnetic fields as an entirely boundary value problem.
